label: Smooth capacity effects while retaining sharp credit-risk responses
formula: V25 original18/globalKumo; BCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.03/2||D2*(beta_spline/scale)||^2 only on capacity inputs; other bases unchanged; shrink.5 and original75:25spline77fusion
rationale: V200 smoothing all17 numeric responses improves AUC and reduces head gap but loses KS. It may over-smooth threshold-like delinquency/bureau effects. Apply the same penalty only to five income/cashflow/burden measurements; keep credit/history-response bases at original L2.

label: Smooth evidence reliability while retaining risk-level thresholds
formula: V25 original18/globalKumo; BCE+.003/2||beta_nonintercept||^2+.03/2||D2*(beta_spline/scale)||^2 only on evidence inputs; other bases unchanged; shrink.5 and original75:25spline77fusion
rationale: Coverage counts and posterior SDs can create unstable residual bends, while burden/delinquency levels may need thresholds. Smooth only8 measurement-reliability/coverage effects; preserve financial-risk response flexibility. This tests a different mechanism from smoothing monetary capacity.
